interface.longDescription: Intake helps small professional firms (accountants, lawyers, lenders) collect documents, intake forms and e-signatures from their clients. From ChatGPT you can see which clients are still missing documents, draft a document request with a checklist and forms, send it to the client's secure portal, review what they uploaded, read submitted form answers, and manage multi-party deals and reusable templates. Sending a request emails the client, so ChatGPT confirms before sending. Answers a firm marks sensitive, payment records and document contents are never returned to ChatGPT.

positive.description: Find requests that still need client action.
positive.prompt: Which of my client requests are overdue or still waiting on documents?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open requests, including Jordan Avery's overdue Inspection Docs request and the requests that are sent but not complete, with client names and progress.

positive.description: Read a client's submitted intake form.
positive.prompt: Show me Marcus Lee's intake form answers on the closing package.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the completed Buyer Intake answers (name, email, phone, income, employment status, etc.). Answers the firm marked sensitive are withheld.

positive.description: Draft a new document request without sending it.
positive.prompt: Create a request for Jordan Avery asking for a 2025 W-2 and a pay stub, but don't send it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft request for Jordan Avery with two checklist items (2025 W-2, pay stub) and confirms it has not been sent.

positive.description: Send a draft request to the client after confirmation.
positive.prompt: Send Jordan Avery the Tax Documents request.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the user to confirm, then sends the draft Tax Documents request; the request status becomes sent and the client receives the portal link by email (captured in the demo account's sandbox inbox).

positive.description: Check what a client has uploaded and what is still missing.
positive.prompt: What has Marcus Lee uploaded for the closing package, and what's still missing?
positive.expected_behavior: Says the W-2 has been uploaded and the Bank Statement and Pay Stub are still missing, and notes the Quick Questionnaire form hasn't been completed yet.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated general questions.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Chicago this weekend?

negative.description: Do not trigger for writing tasks that don't involve Intake data.
negative.prompt: Write a cover letter for a paralegal job application.

negative.description: Do not trigger for files stored in other services.
negative.prompt: Find the tax PDFs in my Google Drive from last year.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Payment tools and payment records are not available to ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: list clients and requests, draft and send document requests, check uploads and read submitted form answers. Payment records, document contents and answers a firm marks sensitive are never returned to ChatGPT.
